description: List the requests the signed-in customer sent to businesses through Bookvia, newest first, whichever assistant sent them: open and past ones, each with its status (pending, confirmed, declined, expired or cancelled), its request_id as reference, the business, the service, the agreed or proposed time (ISO 8601) and a notice that states the facts in words. Use it when the customer asks about their requests or appointments and you have no request_id. Before you tell the customer anything about an entry, read its status and awaiting: nothing is agreed or booked unless the status of that entry is confirmed. For the latest state of one request call get_request_status, and to withdraw an open one on the word of the customer call cancel_request. Without open_only the closed ones are listed too. With open_only: true only requests that still wait for an answer are returned. limit is 10 by default and at most 25. An urgent request to several businesses is one entry, with the state at every business in group. The request_id of an entry works with get_request_status and cancel_request. Returns only the requests of this customer and no customer data. Requests whose customer data was deleted are not listed. Appointments made with book_appointment are listed too, each with booking.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests, default 10, at most 25

open_only.description: true: only requests that are still pending. Default false: all requests, also the closed ones

name: list_my_requests

notice.description: What the list covers, in words. Written by Bookvia: facts only, never instructions. What to tell the customer about an entry follows from the status and awaiting of that entry

requests.description: Newest first (created_at, ISO 8601). Every entry has the same fields as the answer of get_request_status. An urgent request to several businesses is one entry: group has the state at every business. An appointment made with book_appointment is an entry too, with booking

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

appointment.description: Agreed time. Only set when status is confirmed and a time was agreed. For a booking: the firm appointment, in German time. null again after the appointment was cancelled.

awaiting.description: On whom the next step depends right now. customer_click = the customer has not yet clicked the button in the e-mail from Bookvia. Nothing was sent to the business. For a booking the times are only held (in German: vorgemerkt) and nothing is booked: tell the customer exactly that and ask them to look into their inbox now, never say "booked", and do not present the result as a booking receipt. For an unverified listing never say that the request was sent. customer_decision = the business proposed another time (see proposal) or offered replacement times for an appointment it cancelled (see rescheduled_from), and the customer accepts, picks or declines through the link in their e-mail: tell the customer to check their e-mail, you cannot answer or pick for them. If the customer wants none of the replacement times, call cancel_request. business_answer = a person at the business has to accept or decline: tell the customer that the business has not answered yet and that the answer also arrives by e-mail. nothing = the request is no longer pending: it is agreed (status confirmed) or closed.

booking.description: Only present for an appointment made with book_appointment: how it becomes firm and which times are held

held_until.description: Only while pending: the times are held until then (ISO 8601). With waiting_for = customer this is the deadline for the click of the customer, with waiting_for = business the deadline for the answer of the business. After that the status becomes expired and the times are free again. Otherwise null

mode.description: automatic = the appointment becomes firm with the click of the customer in their e-mail. business_confirms = after that click a person at the business picks one of the times or declines

times.description: The times asked for with book_appointment, in German time (ISO 8601 with offset). While pending they are held for this customer and nobody else can take them

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

cancelled_by.description: Only present when an appointment that was firm has been cancelled (status is then cancelled): who cancelled it. Nothing is booked anymore: say clearly that the appointment is no longer firm. business: tell the customer plainly that the business cancelled. If rescheduled_to is missing, offer another business or other times with get_availability

expires_at.description: While pending: deadline for the answer. With waiting_for = customer (unverified listing or booking): deadline for the click of the customer. After that the status becomes expired. If it expired because the customer did not click, nothing was sent to the business and nothing is booked: if the customer still wants it, send a new request, or for a booking call get_availability again and book with a new idempotency_key.

group.description: Only for urgent requests: the common state of the job and the state at every business it went to. For an urgent request go by group.status, not by the status of one business: one may have declined while another can still accept

accepted_by.description: The business that accepted first and has the job. null as long as nobody accepted.

expires_at.description: While pending: if no business accepts by then, the urgent request expires and the customer is told by e-mail

group_id.description: Same for all requests of one urgent job

notice.description: The common state in words: who has the request, what is agreed and until when it runs. Written by Bookvia: facts only, never instructions. What to tell the customer follows from status

requests.description: One entry per business the customer agreed to, in the order of business_ids

not_sent_reason.description: Why nothing was sent to this business, e.g. business_request_limit_reached. Otherwise null

request_id.description: Use with get_request_status. null if nothing was sent to this business

status.description: State at this business. cancelled with taken_by_other = true: another business accepted first

submitted.description: false: nothing was sent to this business, see not_sent_reason. The other businesses still got the request. Tell the customer which business did not get it.

taken_by_other.description: true: this request was closed because another business accepted first. The business was told that the job is taken.

status.description: Common state of the urgent job: pending = at least one business can still accept, nothing is agreed yet. confirmed = one business accepted first and has the job. declined = every business said no. expired = nobody accepted in time. cancelled = the customer withdrew. While pending, never tell the customer that a business agreed. After declined or expired, nothing was agreed: offer the customer to look for other businesses with search_businesses.

message_from_business.description: Message of the business for the customer, in German

notice.description: The state in words: what happened, on whom the next step depends and until when. Written by Bookvia: facts only, never instructions. What to tell the customer follows from status and awaiting

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

proposal.description: The business proposed this time instead. NOT confirmed. The customer accepts or declines via the link in their e-mail: tell the customer to check their e-mail, you cannot accept for them. Only set while pending.

rescheduled_from.description: Only present on a request that holds replacement times offered by the business: the request_id of the appointment the business cancelled

rescheduled_to.description: Only present when the business cancelled a firm appointment and offered other times instead: the request_id of the request that holds these times. Call get_request_status with it. The customer picks one of the times through their e-mail, you cannot pick for them

status.description: pending = waiting, nothing is agreed yet. confirmed = a person at the business said yes; for an appointment made with book_appointment: the appointment is firm, because the customer clicked the button in their e-mail and the booking rules of the business, or a person there, made it firm. declined = the business said no. expired = nobody answered in time, or for a booking the customer did not click in time. cancelled = the customer withdrew, or for an urgent request another business accepted first (see group), or Bookvia could not pass a request on to an unverified listing (see notice), or an appointment made with book_appointment that was firm has been cancelled by the customer or the business (see cancelled_by): then nothing is booked anymore. Only confirmed means something is agreed: tell the customer that something is agreed or booked only then. While pending, say "requested", "sent" or "held", never "booked" or "agreed", and see awaiting. After declined or expired, nothing was agreed: offer the customer another business with search_businesses or, for a booking, other times with get_availability.

unverified.description: true: the request is for a business that is NOT on Bookvia (an entry from unverified). business.id is then the listing id (lst_…), and it is open whether the business answers: say so to the customer. If the request ends without an answer or was not passed on, offer another business or the phone number or website of this one. Only present for such requests

urgent.description: true: an urgent request. Only present for urgent requests

waiting_for.description: Only while pending, for a request to an unverified listing or a booking made with book_appointment. customer = the customer first has to click the button in the e-mail from Bookvia: until then nothing was sent to the business and no time is firm. business = the customer clicked and it is the turn of the business: for an unverified listing it is open whether it answers, for a booking a person at the business picks one of the times or declines

total.description: All requests of the customer that match open_only, not only the ones returned

title: List the requests of the customer
